select option value attribute is not set if value is equal to text
### Version
3.2.22

### Reproduction link
[sfc.vuejs.org/](https://sfc.vuejs.org/#)







### Steps to reproduce
Inspect the select options and see that the option with `value === textContent` has no value set.

### What is expected?
Regardless of the textContent I expected an option to correctly have the value attribute and not silently remove it.

### What is actually happening?
The value attribute is removed.

---
I have verified that this is not happening in vue2. [Reproduction link](https://codesandbox.io/s/vue?file=/src/App.vue)

If I'm missing some part of the [option spec](https://www.w3.org/TR/2011/WD-html5-author-20110809/the-option-element.html) please point me to it. But as far as I am seeing it it is perfectly valid to have an option with value = textContent and I our case needed for e2e testing frameworks like Selenium to select a predefined value.
